content: @babel/standalone is current at 8.0.5 (npm registry). Official docs confirm: it auto-compiles text/babel and text/jsx scripts, supports external scripts via src= loaded through XHR (MIME-agnostic), executes them in document order, and defaults to the react preset with runtime:'classic' in the browser (changelog fix #18086) plus env targeted at esmodules for data-type=module scripts. Babel 8 (June 2026) is ESM-only for Node packages, which does not affect the browser bundle. It logs a warning to precompile for production. Alternatives: esm.sh/run (inline blocks only, verified 1.7 KB loader has no src handling), esm.sh/tsx, or DIY esbuild-wasm — none load external local .jsx files over a plain static server.
